title: Pop-Tarts® Crazy Good Rewards — scan your grocery receipt, earn points, redeem for rewards
offer_text: Pop-Tarts® Crazy Good Rewards — Earn Points, Get Rewards. "Scan your grocery receipt after buying participating Pop-Tarts® products to earn and redeem points for rewards — the more you scan, the more you save!" "You will receive 1 point for every $1 spent on participating Pop-Tarts™ products. You can then redeem these Points for Rewards through the Reward Catalog" (Program Terms). "Sign up to be the first to know about new flavors, drops, swag and get personalized content and exclusive coupons!"
expiry_basis: Standing program; the issuer publishes no end date.
requirements: Free account at poptarts.com (email and date of birth requested at sign-up)
Buy participating Pop-Tarts® products in a physical store
Upload the grocery receipt through the program to earn points; rewards are redeemed through the account

bay_area.note: Shopping happens at any Bay Area grocery store that stocks Pop-Tarts; the receipt scan and redemption are done on Kellanova's official site. No store list is required by the program.

flags.detail: Earning and redemption require a free Kellanova account; the participating-product list, reward catalogue and promotional point multipliers are behind login and are therefore not enumerated here. The base earning rate itself is published in the Program Terms.
The rewards landing page offers only 'I'm New' / 'I already joined' entry points to an anonymous visitor; no public terms PDF was linked from the page.

The Program Terms citation (the 1-point-per-$1 earning ladder) came from a search-engine snippet of the issuer's official terms page on 2026-09-22; the full terms document was not machine-read. The quoted rate is the issuer's own wording, but a reviewer opening the URL should expect the same text rendered inside the full legal page.
